subject: Tranche remit acceptance and VAT evidence — OptimaHealth
messages:
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@optimahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@optimahealth.com; Jeff Kramer <jeff.kramer@optimahealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Net60 with milestone tranche remit + VAT evidence

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week — product looked promising. Finance at OptimaHealth is pushing for Net60 on the initial contract, but they are willing to split payments across two tranches tied to pilot milestones. They also need a clear VAT/data export pathway for our EU subsidiary to issue correct invoices.

High level ask: would Redwood accept a two-tranche payment schedule (50% on PO issuance / 50% within 45 days of pilot acceptance) with Net60 on the final tranche, provided we provide a signed PO and VAT registration for our EU entity?

If you can share a short payment schedule and a list of VAT documents Redwood needs, we can push this through procurement next week. Attaching Optima's proposed schedule for reference.

Attachments: Optima_Proposed_Payment_Schedule.xlsx

Cheers,
Sophie Martin
Head of Procurement
OptimaHealth
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 with milestone tranche remit + VAT evidence

Hi Sophie — great to hear from you and glad the demo was useful.

Thanks for the proposed schedule. We can be flexible but want to align on a few guardrails to protect both sides. Draft response below and I've looped Finance for a quick credit/terms check.

Proposed Redwood response (summary):
- Acceptance in principle of a two-tranche approach: 50% on PO (invoice immediate), 50% on pilot acceptance (invoice on acceptance).
- Standard payment window: Net45 on the second tranche for new enterprise pilots. We can extend to Net60 for subsequent invoices conditional on a credit review and VAT evidence.
- For the EU VAT flow: provide optima's EU VAT registration and your invoicing/billing entity details. We will route VAT invoices to your EU subsidiary once we confirm VAT registration.
- Security/perf holdback: no local retention unless pre-agreed; any contract holdbacks should be explicit in the PO.

Action items for Optima we need to progress:
1) Signed PO referencing RDW-OPT-2026-0123
2) VAT registration PDF for EU subsidiary
3) Purchase order billing entity and remit-to details

I'm attaching a short checklist (VAT_Registration_Checklist.pdf) and a sample PO template (Redwood-TS-PO-sample.pdf). Marcus / Monica — can you review the conditional Net60 language below and confirm credit guardrails?

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Head of Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: VAT_Registration_Checklist.pdf, Redwood-TS-PO-sample.pdf
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>; Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@optimahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 08:23:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 with milestone tranche remit + VAT evidence

On Thu, Nov 12, 2026 at 11:02 AM Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I'm attaching a short checklist (VAT_Registration_Checklist.pdf) and a sample PO template (Redwood-TS-PO-sample.pdf). Marcus / Monica — can you review the conditional Net60 language below and confirm credit guardrails?

Quick finance take: we can accept the two-tranche flow but recommend a conservative credit path for a first engagement. Proposed guardrails: 
- Invoice 1 (50%): Net30 upon PO issuance (helps us with cashflow for reserved capacity).
- Invoice 2 (50%): Net45 upon pilot acceptance for first 90 days of engagement; upgrade to Net60 after 90 days of on-time payments and no missed collections.
- Required documentation before Net60 granted: signed PO, proof of VAT registration for EU entity, and PO remit-to verification (bank details).
- Credit hold: if any payment is >15 days late, we revert to prepay until account restored.

If Optima insists on Net60 on invoice 2 from day 1, we can consider it with a 10% deposit on top of the 50% PO invoice or a short-term rolling credit line under a signed credit addendum.

I'll add this into the HubSpot deal notes and draft suggested contract language.

- Marcus
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@optimahealth.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jeff Kramer <jeff.kramer@optimahealth.com>; procure@optimahealth.com
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 09:33:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 with milestone tranche remit + VAT evidence

Evelyn / Marcus — thanks for the quick review. A few clarifications from our side: 
- Optima can accept Net30 on the first invoice if the pilot acceptance invoice is Net60, but procurement prefers Net45 on the second tranche if possible.
- We will provide the EU VAT registration PDF this afternoon and draft a PO that references RDW-OPT-2026-0123.
- On the deposit: procurement will avoid extra deposits where possible; if Net60 is conditional on a small security (e.g., 5% escrow), we can consider it.

I'll upload the VAT PDF into the DocuSign envelope we're preparing and share a link when the PO is ready. Plan to finalize by EOD Wednesday.

Thanks,
Sophie
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sophie Martin <sophie.martin@optimahealth.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 15:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Net60 with milestone tranche remit + VAT evidence

Hi Sophie — appreciate the fast turnaround. Confirming Redwood's conditional acceptance below so procurement can proceed: 

Finalized terms (for PO and SOW):
- Two-tranche billing: Invoice A (50%) billed on PO issuance — Net30.
- Invoice B (50%) billed on pilot acceptance — Net45 for the first 90 days; upgrade to Net60 after 3 consecutive months of on-time payments and completed pilot acceptance criteria.
- Prior to Net60 upgrade: Optima to provide EU VAT registration (PDF), remit-to bank verification, and a signed PO referencing deal RDW-OPT-2026-0123.
- Short security option: 5% refundable security can substitute for deposit if procurement requires.
- Late payment remedy: >15 days past due triggers billing hold and requirement for prepayment on subsequent invoices until account is current.

Next steps:
1) Sophie — send the VAT PDF and PO link (we will confirm receipt).
2) We'll generate a credit addendum and DocuSign packet (link below) for signatures once PO is received.
3) Marcus will add the credit path into HubSpot and mark the deal for conditional Net60.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/recipient-view/example-id-998877
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Once everyone signs, we'll proceed to invoice A on PO issuance.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: Optima_Proposed_Payment_Schedule.xlsx, VAT_Registration_Checklist.pdf, Redwood-TS-PO-sample.pdf
